name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Food truck ordering and kitchen
promotionalText: Take pre-orders, protect the kitchen from too many orders and keep working when the network drops. The ordering app for the food truck team.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app for food trucks: the tool your team runs service with.

Customers order ahead and choose a collection time. Your staff see every order on one screen, confirm what the kitchen can cook, then mark the order as ready and collected.

DON’T PROMISE A TIME YOU’LL BE LATE FOR
Set how much your kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. When a collection time is full, customers can’t choose it, so the queue matches the kitchen’s capacity.

TAKE ORDERS ON THE SPOT
Add on-the-spot orders to the same screen as pre-orders, so the kitchen works from a single queue.

ONE SCREEN FOR THE KITCHEN
The kitchen screen shows what needs making now, the next order and what’s ready, and warns you when it’s time to start an order.

PRINT ORDER TICKETS
Connect the kitchen receipt printer over Bluetooth or the local network, so order tickets print automatically.

KEEP SERVING EVEN WHEN THE NETWORK DROPS
Switch on offline protection: if the connection breaks, ordering ahead stops, so nobody can place an order you don’t see. Orders you take on the device are kept and synced when the connection is restored.

MADE FOR THE FOOD TRUCK
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen on during service, get a notification when an order needs confirming, and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

PLAN YOUR WEEK
Set up your events and venues once and take orders for each of them.

HatchGrab is for food truck owners and their staff. You need a HatchGrab account to sign in.
